title: Bug: --runxfail breaks skip location reporting
text: When --runxfail is used, pytest.mark.skip reports location as src/_pytest/skipping.py instead of test file line

title: Root cause identified
text: In pytest_runtest_makereport hook, the skipped_by_mark_key check (which fixes location) was placed AFTER the runxfail pass-through branch, causing early exit

title: Fix applied
text: Moved the skipped_by_mark_key elif block to execute BEFORE the runxfail branch, ensuring skip location is always corrected

title: Issue root cause identified
text: In TestCaseFunction.runtest() at line 319, when --pdb is given, tearDown() is postponed by storing it in _explicit_tearDown. Original check only looked at method-level skip (self.obj), missing class-level skip decorator.

title: Fix applied
text: Added _is_skipped(self._testcase) check alongside existing _is_skipped(self.obj) to handle class-level @unittest.skip decorator

title: Fix verified
text: Test reproduction script confirms fix works: skipped test stays skipped with and without --pdb

title: Root cause identified
text: set_level() only restores logger levels via _initial_logger_levels, but never saves/restores handler.level

title: Missing restoration
text: _finalize() only restores logger levels, not the handler's level

title: Root cause identified
text: LogCaptureHandler.reset() creates new list (self.records = []) instead of clearing existing list. When caplog.clear() calls handler.reset(), the records reference in item.stash becomes stale.

title: First fix attempt failed
text: Changed reset() to use self.records.clear() - broke existing tests because reset() is used internally to create independent copies for stash

title: Second fix approach
text: Modified LogCaptureFixture.clear() to directly clear handler.records and handler.stream instead of calling handler.reset()
